components.text:
On earlier versions of the mod, this slot was filled by two separate rituals: "Edge of the Hidden Realm" (a simple version) and "Pathway to the Endless Realm" (a more advanced version), both opening a passage to a self-contained loot dungeon. On this branch they have been consolidated into a single Ritual of the Vault. Tier 1, costs $(blood)200,000 LP$() to activate.
Use a Ritual Diviner for easier construction.

Note: the broader Demon Dungeon generation system (keys, mimics, dungeon-specific hazards, etc.) that the old dungeon rituals led into has not been fully carried over to this branch yet - treat the destination content as a work in progress.
